title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes & version bump v1.32.0
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: SDK parity drift has caused inconsistent retry behaviour and streaming ergonomics between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. This PR unifies auth refresh + retry semantics, tightens streaming backpressure/stream APIs for parity, and bumps the SDK package versions to v1.32.0.

What changed (high-level):
- Python: centralize token refresh logic, expose configurable RetryPolicy, and make streaming client use chunked generator semantics for easier async iteration.
- TypeScript: fix streaming backpressure bug that caused dropped frames under high throughput; align retry/backoff defaults with Python; improve typings for function-calls and structured responses.
- Go: port the unified RetryPolicy and adjust context cancellation behavior to match other SDKs; add compatibility shims where API shapes differed.
- Chore: bump SDK package versions to v1.32.0 across all SDK packages and update changelogs and migration notes.

Notes: this is a single PR that touches multiple SDK packages in the monorepo. Changes were implemented with conservative defaults to avoid breaking user code. Migration notes included in release notes.

Testing: unit tests added for retry backoff, token refresh, and streaming consumers in each SDK. End-to-end smoke tests run in CI against a staging control plane.

Related: Linear ENG-3421, ENG-3589, ENG-3642.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Please ensure retry defaults are conservative; we should not alter transient error semantics for existing users.
Maya Patel: Agreed, defaults preserved where possible; introduced RetryPolicy to allow opt-in stronger behavior. Added migration note explaining default remains exponential backoff (max 4 retries).
Ana Rodriguez: TypeScript streaming types look good but add a small test for backpressure when consumers are slow.
Maya Patel: Added backpressure test (streaming.spec.ts) and validated memory usage in CI.
Priya Singh: Go context cancellation behavior needs explicit docs — callers should cancel contexts to stop streaming. Add example.
Maya Patel: Added example to docs/sdk-migration-v1.32.0.md and inline Go doc comments.
release_notes:
- Unified auth token refresh and RetryPolicy across Python/TS/Go.
- Streaming API ergonomics improved: backpressure handling and clearer async iteration patterns.
- Backwards-compatible defaults preserved; opt-in stronger retry configs available.
- SDKs bumped to v1.32.0. See docs/sdk-migration-v1.32.0.md for migration steps.
